organizations.name: 180 Degrees Consulting
organizations.tagline: Pro-bono consulting for nonprofits and social enterprises in Waco.
organizations.mission: A student-led consulting organization that partners with nonprofits and social enterprises to grow their impact in Waco and beyond — part of the world's largest university-based consultancy for social impact.
organizations.culture: Interdisciplinary teams, real clients, and a strong service mindset. Projects run a full semester.

benefits.label: Real client work in your first semester

organizations.joinDetails: Short application and a conversational interview each semester.

organizations.name: The Consulting Group at Baylor
organizations.tagline: Case prep, firm connections and real client projects.
organizations.mission: Helps students succeed in consulting careers through case-interview workshops, firm info sessions, networking events and real-world consulting projects for businesses.
organizations.culture: Driven, collaborative and practice-heavy. New members join case pods that meet weekly; experienced members lead client engagements each semester.

benefits.label: Weekly case practice with a pod
Client project experience for your resume

organizations.joinDetails: General meetings are open. Project teams use a short application each semester.
organizations.recruitingWindow: Project team applications · early each semester
organizations.sizeNote: Published on the club's team page

organizations.name: Baylor Finance and Investment Club
organizations.tagline: Pitch ideas, manage a portfolio, compete as a team.
organizations.mission: Founded in 2023 for students passionate about financial markets. Members meet weekly in teams to pitch investment ideas and learn portfolio management, with guest speakers and career support.
organizations.culture: Team-based investment competition. You'll research, pitch and defend a position every few weeks.

benefits.label: A team and a portfolio from week one
Pitch reps that prepare you for interviews

organizations.joinDetails: Join a team at the start of each semester; late joiners are placed on existing teams.
organizations.sizeNote: Founding-year figure published by BFIC; not a live count

organizations.name: Investment and Advisory Network
organizations.tagline: Recruiting prep for IB, PE and hedge funds.
organizations.mission: Junior and senior liaisons work with sophomores recruiting for investment banking, private equity and hedge fund internships — technical content, mock interviews and alumni networking.
organizations.joinDetails: Primarily for sophomores; application and interview.

organizations.name: Oso Launch
organizations.tagline: A selective accelerator for Baylor students already running real businesses.
organizations.mission: A student-led accelerator housed with the Baugh Center that helps founders scale existing ventures through mentorship, strategic guidance, funding opportunities and a high-performance founder community.
organizations.culture: Small, selective cohort. Weekly founder sessions, mentor office hours, and honest traction reviews.

benefits.label: Mentor guidance on your actual venture
A cohort of founders who hold you accountable

organizations.joinDetails: For students who already operate a business with customers or revenue. Apply with a short venture summary; finalists meet the team. Matching on this site is a suggestion, not admission.

organizations.name: Delta Sigma Pi
organizations.tagline: Professionalism, service, scholarship and lifelong brotherhood.
organizations.mission: An international, co-educational business fraternity open to all business majors, built on four pillars: professionalism, service, social life and scholarship.
organizations.culture: Expect a close-knit pledge class, weekly chapter meetings, professional development nights with alumni, and service projects across Waco. Members describe it as the place they found both career guidance and their closest friends.

benefits.label: A pledge class that becomes your first business network
Resume reviews and mock interviews from upperclassmen
An alumni network across Texas firms

organizations.joinDetails: Attend at least one rush event, submit a short application, then a casual interview. Rush is open to all business majors.

organizations.name: Alpha Kappa Psi
organizations.tagline: The world's largest business fraternity, at Baylor for 60+ years.
organizations.mission: A co-ed professional business fraternity for all class years. Activities include professional speakers, service projects, alumni events and social functions.
organizations.culture: Large, energetic chapter with a tight-knit community; strong alumni ties after more than six decades at Baylor.

benefits.label: A built-in community from day one
One of the largest business alumni networks

organizations.joinDetails: Attend rush week events, apply, then interview.

organizations.name: Scholars of Finance
organizations.tagline: Technical finance skills with ethical leadership.
organizations.mission: Combines technical finance proficiency with foundational leadership skills and professional development, equipping members to be stewards of change in the finance industry.
organizations.culture: Seminar-style sessions, reading groups and leadership development alongside technical training.
organizations.joinDetails: Apply at the start of each semester.

organizations.name: Startup and Innovation Club
organizations.tagline: For current and aspiring founders of every major.
organizations.mission: Gives current and aspiring student entrepreneurs the resources, community and foundation for future ventures — from first-years who are curious to students already running startups.
organizations.culture: Builders and tinkerers. Meetings mix founder talks, idea jams and quick pitch practice. No business plan required to show up.

benefits.label: Pitch an idea in a low-stakes room
A path into accelerators like Oso Launch

organizations.joinDetails: Show up — membership is open to all Baylor students.

organizations.name: AI Society
organizations.tagline: Explore, build and discuss applied artificial intelligence.
organizations.mission: A student community exploring how artificial intelligence is changing business and technology, with build nights, demos and discussion.
organizations.culture: Hands-on and curious. Members bring side projects, trade prompts and tools, and help each other ship demos.

benefits.label: Build nights with peers who code and peers who don't

organizations.joinDetails: Open to any Baylor student. Bring a laptop.

organizations.name: Accounting Society at Baylor
organizations.tagline: Professional growth within a caring community.
organizations.mission: Enriches the lives of accounting students by cultivating professional growth and academic excellence within a community dedicated to servant leadership and Christian values.
organizations.culture: Welcoming to first-years still deciding on accounting. Firm nights, study sessions before exams, and service projects.

benefits.label: Meet Big Four and regional firms early
A head start on internship recruiting

organizations.joinDetails: Pay semester dues at any meeting. First meeting free.

organizations.name: Bears' Association for Human Resources
organizations.tagline: Grow in HR knowledge and network with HR professionals.
organizations.mission: Empowers students to grow in human-resources knowledge, network with HR professionals, and build relationships with fellow students and faculty.
organizations.culture: Friendly and practical. Speaker lunches, SHRM-style case discussions and resume nights.
organizations.joinDetails: Open to all majors; dues collected each semester.

organizations.name: Real Estate Network at Baylor
organizations.tagline: Students, alumni and employers in real estate.
organizations.mission: Builds a network of students interested in real estate, alumni in the field and recruiting employers through speaker events.

organizations.name: Women in Business at Baylor
organizations.tagline: A strong network of women in business.
organizations.mission: Develops a strong network of women with opportunities for personal growth and business relationships, integrating professional insight, integrity and leadership through Christian faith.
organizations.sizeNote: Published by Hankamer; not a live count

organizations.name: American Marketing Association at Baylor
organizations.tagline: Marketing skills and networks beyond the classroom.
organizations.mission: Provides professional development, networking and educational opportunities in a welcoming environment for students interested in marketing.
organizations.culture: Creative and social — agency visits, brand challenges and portfolio nights.

organizations.name: Hankamer Student Organization
organizations.tagline: The student voice of the business school since 1992.
organizations.mission: Serves as a liaison between Hankamer students and the Dean, helps organize business-school events and supports business student organizations.
organizations.culture: Service-minded student leaders who plan school-wide events and represent students to faculty and administration.

opportunities.title: Hankamer Fall Kickoff in the Atrium
opportunities.summary: Meet every Business Council organization in one place — tables, games and a chance to talk to officers.
opportunities.gain: Meet the council organizations and leave knowing which two or three fit you.
opportunities.nextStep: Just walk in. No RSVP needed.

opportunities.title: Case Interview 101
opportunities.summary: A hands-on walkthrough of a market-sizing case with live feedback. Designed for students who have never seen a case.
opportunities.gain: You'll leave able to structure a basic case — the first skill consulting recruiters screen for.
opportunities.nextStep: RSVP on Baylor Connect so we print enough case packets.

opportunities.title: Build Night: AI Tools for Class Projects
opportunities.summary: Bring a laptop and a class project. We'll pair you with someone who has shipped with the same tools.
opportunities.gain: A working prototype and a peer you can text when you get stuck.
opportunities.nextStep: Show up with a laptop. Coding experience optional.

opportunities.title: HR Leaders Lunch: Life as an HR Business Partner
opportunities.summary: A conversation with an HR business partner from a Texas health system about what the job is really like.
opportunities.gain: Understand a day in HR and ask about internships directly.
opportunities.nextStep: Seats are limited — RSVP on Baylor Connect.

opportunities.title: Chapter Meeting & Professional Night
opportunities.summary: Weekly chapter business followed by a resume workshop led by alumni.
opportunities.gain: Alumni feedback on your resume and a say in this semester's service plans.
opportunities.nextStep: Members check the chapter group for details.

opportunities.title: Brotherhood Retreat Planning (officers)
opportunities.summary: Internal officer planning session.
opportunities.gain: Lock in the retreat agenda, budget and roles.
opportunities.nextStep: Bring your committee updates.

opportunities.title: Stock Pitch Night
opportunities.summary: Teams pitch long and short ideas to a panel of finance faculty. Open audience — vote for the best pitch.
opportunities.gain: Watch how strong pitches are structured before you have to give one in an interview.
opportunities.nextStep: Come watch; no sign-up needed.

opportunities.title: Meet the Firms Night
opportunities.summary: Representatives from public accounting firms talk about internships and the CPA path.
opportunities.gain: Get on recruiters' radar a full year before internship applications open.
opportunities.nextStep: Business casual. RSVP on Baylor Connect.

opportunities.title: Social Impact Consulting Info Session
opportunities.summary: Hear from consultants who just finished a semester with a Waco nonprofit, and learn how recruiting works.
opportunities.gain: Learn how to get client experience in your first semester — no prior consulting needed.
opportunities.nextStep: Attend, then apply by the deadline below.

opportunities.title: Idea Jam & Founder Fireside
opportunities.summary: A Baylor alum who started a company in college shares what she wishes she'd known, then small-group idea jams.
opportunities.gain: Meet potential co-founders and test an idea in a friendly room.
opportunities.nextStep: Walk in — all majors welcome.
opportunities.changeNote: Moved from Thursday to Friday; same time and room.

opportunities.title: Ethics in Finance Reading Group
opportunities.summary: A short reading and a structured discussion on ethical decision-making in capital markets.
opportunities.gain: Practice articulating your values — a question every finance interviewer asks.
opportunities.nextStep: Request the reading from the officer contact.

opportunities.title: Professional Speaker: First Year at a Dallas Firm
opportunities.summary: A recent graduate talks about the transition from Baylor to a first job.
opportunities.gain: Hear realistic advice about the first year of work.
opportunities.nextStep: Open to all — just come.
opportunities.changeNote: Speaker had a conflict; we'll post a new date.

opportunities.title: Brand Challenge Kickoff
opportunities.summary: Teams get a real brief from a regional brand and two weeks to pitch a campaign.
opportunities.gain: A portfolio piece and feedback from working marketers.
opportunities.nextStep: Form a team of 3–4 at the kickoff.

opportunities.title: Technical Interview Bootcamp: Accounting Basics
opportunities.summary: Walk through the three statements the way interviewers ask about them.
opportunities.gain: Answer the most common technical questions with confidence.
opportunities.nextStep: Sophomores recruiting for junior-summer roles should prioritize this.

opportunities.title: Commercial Real Estate Site Visit
opportunities.summary: Tour a downtown Waco redevelopment project with the developer.
opportunities.gain: See a real project's numbers and decisions on site.
opportunities.nextStep: Limited to 20 — sign up with the officer contact.
opportunities.location: Downtown Waco (meet at Foster front steps)

opportunities.title: Mentorship Circle Launch
opportunities.summary: Get matched into a small circle with an upperclass mentor for the semester.
opportunities.gain: A mentor who has been through recruiting at Baylor.
opportunities.nextStep: Sign up at the event.

opportunities.title: Dean's Student Forum
opportunities.summary: Share feedback with the Dean about the business school experience.
opportunities.gain: Your voice in decisions about Hankamer.
opportunities.nextStep: Walk in; questions can be submitted ahead of time.

opportunities.title: Demo Day: Student AI Projects
opportunities.summary: Ten-minute demos of student-built AI tools, followed by open Q&A.
opportunities.gain: See what's possible — and find a project to join.
opportunities.nextStep: Come watch; demo slots open to members.

opportunities.title: Nonprofit Client Showcase
opportunities.summary: Members present recommendations to their Waco nonprofit clients.
opportunities.gain: Practice presenting real recommendations to a client audience.
opportunities.nextStep: Team leads confirm slides by Wednesday.

opportunities.title: Service Saturday at a Waco Community Garden
opportunities.summary: Members spend a morning helping a local community garden prep for fall.
opportunities.gain: A morning of service with your chapter and service hours logged.
opportunities.nextStep: Sign up in the chapter group so drivers can plan.

opportunities.title: Oso Launch Spring Cohort Applications
opportunities.summary: Founders who already operate a business with customers or revenue can apply for the spring cohort.
opportunities.gain: Mentorship, a founder cohort and investor introductions for a venture you're already running.
opportunities.nextStep: Submit a short venture summary by the deadline. A match on this site is a suggestion — not admission.

opportunities.title: Consultant Recruiting — Spring Projects
opportunities.summary: Join a team advising a Waco nonprofit or social enterprise next semester.
opportunities.gain: Real client work you can talk about in every interview.
opportunities.nextStep: Apply online, then a 20-minute conversational interview.

opportunities.title: Client Project Team Applications
opportunities.summary: Apply to join a semester-long consulting engagement with a regional business.
opportunities.gain: Hands-on consulting experience before recruiting season.
opportunities.nextStep: Short application; no interview for returning members.

opportunities.title: HSO Committee Applications
opportunities.summary: Help plan school-wide events and represent students to Hankamer leadership.
opportunities.gain: Leadership experience and direct work with the Dean's office.
opportunities.nextStep: Apply with a short form.

opportunities.title: Scholars of Finance Spring Applications
opportunities.summary: Apply to join the spring cohort focused on technical finance and ethical leadership.
opportunities.gain: Technical training plus a leadership cohort.
opportunities.nextStep: Submit the application by the deadline.
